name: buyback_arb
summary: Small-shareholder tender arb; edge on selected high-acceptance, high-premium small-caps. Post-Oct-2024 it needs a <=20% tax slab (~0 after tax at 30%). The one validated edge.

name: mean_reversion
summary: RSI + 20% below 200-DMA + quality. No edge vs buy-and-hold after costs; informational lens only.

name: smart_money_deals
summary: Follow institutional bulk/block buys. Post-disclosure return ~0 (front-run pre-event); informational lens only.

name: merger_arb
summary: Stock-swap long-target/short-acquirer. Thin, efficiently priced; deal-break tail risk.

name: open_offer_arb
summary: No small-shareholder reservation -> no structural edge. Control that proves the buyback thesis.

name: index_rebalance
summary: Front-run NIFTY 50/Next 50 reconstitution forced flows. Null: the change is publicly pre-announced ~4wks out, so the flow is arbitraged before a follower can act (n=151 Next 50; tight window flat; the lone deletion-rebound was a 2021-22 regime artifact). Pre-announced forced flow has no barrier keeping competitors out -- contrast the buyback quota.

name: lockin_expiry
summary: Anchor lock-in unlock dip: T-1->T+2 vs NIFTY 500 = -1.25% at the 90-day unlock (t=-4.6, n=573), -0.7% at 30d; same-stock placebo windows ~0; holds 2022-26. Not shortable by retail (new IPOs aren't in F&O) -> use as an avoid / exit-timing rule for recent IPOs, not a trade.

name: fno_ban
summary: F&O ban (95% MWPL) reversal. Null: n=920 episodes 2020-26 -- the pre-ban move does not reverse at entry, during, exit or after (all |t|<1, no better than same-stock controls). The ban blocks fresh derivatives but the cash market stays open to everyone, so nothing is fenced off. Real-looking effects (sold-into-ban names keep falling during the ban) sit where retail can't short.

name: rights_re
summary: Rights entitlements trade below fair value S - issue price: median +3.5% of the share price on liquid days (55 non-penny, fully-paid issues 2020-26, 291 days; 48/55 above cost). Capturable without shorting only if you want the stock (buy RE + subscribe instead) or hold it (switch shares -> REs). Small capacity.

name: promoter_buying
summary: Follow promoter open-market buys (SAST Reg 29). Worked 2020-23 (+60d median ~+5%) but gone in 2024-26 (big stakes -1.0%, clusters -1.6%, <50% up); the pooled +8% mean is a small-cap fat tail (median +0.9%). Decayed drift signal -- informational lens only.

name: order_wins
summary: Follow disclosed order wins (Reg 30). The market prices them on the day (+0.9%, +2.0% for orders >=25% of revenue) and a follower gets nothing: +1/+5/+20d abnormal ~0 to slightly negative, below same-stock controls (n=1,638, 2024-26). Informational lens only.
